newsitem.title: POLAND: Universal postpones bonds issue decision.
newsitem.headline: Universal postpones bonds issue decision.

text.p: Polish trading firm Universal SA general shareholders meeting postponed its decision on a planned 81-million zloty convertible bonds issue until next month, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
It did not give any further details.
The company earlier said it planned to offer 810 five-year, 12 percent convertible bonds with a face value of 100,000 zlotys at par in a private placement to no more than 300 selected investors.
The bonds due on October 1, 2001 could be converted into the company's stock from February 1,1997 until September 30, 2001.
Each bond would be exchanged for 10,000 new common shares with a par value of five zlotys each.
